title: Ousiometrics and Telegnomics: The essence of meaning conforms to a two-dimensional {powerful ⇔ weak} and {dangerous ⇔ safe} framework with diverse corpora presenting a safety bias
reasoning: The paper explores 'ousiometrics' (from the theological/philosophical Greek 'ousia' for essence) and explicitly utilizes moral and ethical frameworks, such as the Dungeons & Dragons alignment chart ({good ⇔ evil} and {lawful ⇔ chaotic}), to interpret the essential meaning of words. It also seeks to map these dimensions to 'states-of-being' and survival instincts.
